title: Creatinine

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Creatinine is a normal waste product made when muscles are used. The kidneys usually filter it out of the blood and remove it in urine, so a blood creatinine test is commonly used to help check how well the kidneys filter.
context: Normal levels depend on muscle mass, diet, age and activity. A single result on its own cannot identify a specific condition, and results are often used together with other tests such as eGFR.
aboveRange: Changes in how well the kidneys filter, or reduced blood flow to the kidneys
Intense exercise, or a diet high in meat
belowRange: Low muscle mass, for example from ageing or a long illness
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
